kpis.description_fr: Net Bookings FY24 (commandes nettes). Indicateur leading critique pour ASML : visibilité 12-18 mois sur revenue. Forte volatilité par cycle.
kpis.description_en: FY24 Net Bookings. Critical leading indicator for ASML: 12-18 months revenue visibility. High cyclical volatility.

kpis.description_fr: Unités EUV livrées FY24. Monopole mondial. Variation liée aux cycles d'investissement TSMC/Samsung/Intel. Prix par unité ~180M€.
kpis.description_en: EUV units shipped FY24. Global monopoly. Variation tied to TSMC/Samsung/Intel investment cycles. ~€180M per unit price.

kpis.description_fr: Livraisons High-NA EUV (EXE:5000) FY24. Nouvelle génération à 380M€/unité. Permet sub-2nm. Adoption Intel/TSMC en 2025-2026.
kpis.description_en: High-NA EUV shipments (EXE:5000) FY24. New generation at €380M/unit. Enables sub-2nm. Intel/TSMC adoption 2025-2026.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Service & upgrades (Installed Base Management) FY24. Récurrent, cushion contre cyclicité. Cible 8-9 Mds€ en 2030.
kpis.description_en: Service & upgrades revenue (Installed Base Management) FY24. Recurring, cyclical buffer. €8-9Bn target by 2030.

kpis.description_fr: Marge brute FY24 (mix défavorable High-NA early stage + Service Asia). Cible 56-60% en 2030 avec ramp High-NA mature.
kpis.description_en: Gross margin FY24 (unfavorable mix High-NA early stage + Service Asia). 56-60% target by 2030 with mature High-NA ramp.

kpis_story.description_fr: Part Chine dans CA FY24 (DUV restant, EUV interdit US/NL export controls). Normalisation prévue 2025-2026 vers 20-25% post controls.
kpis_story.description_en: China share of FY24 revenue (DUV remaining, EUV banned by US/NL export controls). Normalization expected 2025-2026 toward 20-25% post controls.

_notes: EUV monopoly. Source: AR FY24 + Capital Markets Day 2024.
